paired_round_ratio_summary.percentile_method: nearest rank across round-paired ABBA block means
paired_round_ratio_summary.definition: ((B1 elapsed + B2 elapsed) / 2) / ((A1 elapsed + A2 elapsed) / 2); equal call counts cancel

interpretation_limit: This is one observation-method microbenchmark on one prepared state and host. Ratios describe paired blocks, not a causal whole-flight or render-frame speedup.
